name: hamlet
note: The approved-look reference state: a settled village with a working harbour. Mirrors designs/cabinet-world-state-today-2026-07-26.png.
provenance: EVERY rung name below is a real rung of that ladder in cabinet/world/growth-ladders.yml, and every count is the ladder's own count. Inventing a rung would be inventing a measurement — which is the exact defect check_era's rung arm exists to catch, so a fixture that made it up would be turning the check off. `packs_inherited` carries no stage because it is not a ladder at all: it is a census count (cabinet/world/morphology.yml:178, harbour cranes = extension packs present). WIDENED 2026-07-27 (law_plot, veto_plinth, noticeboard, journal_desk, flagpole, observatory, pens, water_store, composter, lantern_posts, posts_lit, and the outbuildings count) for one reason: those ladders had NO PLACEMENT RULE AT ALL until iso-layout/dressing.ts, so the fixture could not have moved anything on the island and the first frame ever drawn was judged under-furnished against the approved still. Each rung is chosen the same way every rung already here was — a real rung name of that ladder, at the settled-village end of it — and NOT computed from the ladder's metric. This file is a STATE, not a census reading; saying so is the difference between a fixture and a claim about the org.
